title: How to Care for Premium Cashmere Knitwear
excerpt: Simple care habits help cashmere and premium knitwear keep their hand feel, shape, and refined surface.
content: Wash cold by hand or dry clean according to the garment label. Dry flat, avoid hanging heavy knitwear, and store folded between wears.
